Name: Salmonberry and blackberry smoothies - Eat berries faster
Author: snowymoonowls
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Turn 5 salmonberries or blackberries into smoothies so you don't have to stand there shoving berries in your mouth for five minutes. Health and energy is five points higher than eating them raw (assuming base quality). Both recipes are known by default so they can be made as soon as you have access to a kitchen or cookout kit.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] installed, then unzip into your mod folder[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
